draft.session_yaml:
session:
  name: earth-meo-gps
  display_name: Earth GPS-altitude MEO
  description: GPS-altitude 24-node MEO shell with MEO gateway sites.
segments:
- id: meo
  source: nodalarc:constellations/earth/meo/earth-meo-gps-24.yaml
- id: ground
  placement:
    from_site_set: nodalarc:site-sets/earth/meo/earth-meo-gateway-sites.yaml
  apply:
    scheduling:
      selection_policy:
        longest_remaining_pass:
          lookahead_horizon_ticks: 7200
      handover_policy:
        hard_release: {}
      handover_mode: bbm
      mbb_overlap_ticks: 0
      mbb_reserve: 0
      handover_concurrency: one_at_a_time
      ranking_order:
      - service_priority
      - selection_score
      - satellite_ground_terminal_capacity
      - lex_pair
      mbb_preemption: 'off'
      successor_abort_policy: hard_release
      cross_tenant_displacement: 'off'
      bbm_acquire_timeout_ticks: 1
link_rules:
- id: meo_access
  topology:
    mode: visible_candidates
  endpoints:
  - select:
      all:
      - segment: ground
      - tag: meo
    terminal:
      all:
      - role: access
      - medium: rf
    min_elevation_deg: 10
  - select:
      segment: meo
    terminal:
      all:
      - role: access
      - medium: rf
- id: meo_isl
  topology:
    mode: nearest_n
    n: 2
  endpoints:
  - select:
      segment: meo
    terminal:
      all:
      - role: isl
      - medium: optical
  - select:
      segment: meo
    terminal:
      all:
      - role: isl
      - medium: optical
simulation:
  candidate_limits:
    max_pairs_per_rule: 500
    max_pairs_per_tick: 2000
time:
  start_time: '2026-06-08T00:00:00Z'
  step_seconds: 1
  compression: 1

session.description: GPS-altitude 24-node MEO shell with MEO gateway sites.
session.name: earth-meo-gps
